title: Finite whole-tower integral and rational pullback comparison datum
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, an algebraic closure $\Omega/\mathbf Q_\ell$, noetherian finite-dimensional schemes $U,T$ on which $\ell$ is invertible, a scheme isomorphism $h:U\simeq T$, and coefficient comparison data $C_U,C_T$ of [def-fd-coefficient-comparison-datum]. For each finite $E\subset\Omega$, write $I_{T,E}$ and $J_{T,E}$ for their integral and raw rational equivalences. A finite pullback comparison datum consists of an integral natural isomorphism $Lh^{*,\mathrm{pbc}}I_{T,E}\simeq I_{U,E}Lh^{*,\mathrm{sf}}$ for the actual operations of [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom] and [def-weil-pbc-completed-pullback], its ambient lift, and a rational natural isomorphism obtained from it by the recorded raw localization. The ambient integral comparison is normalized as follows. There is a natural chain map from coefficient-transported ordinary PBC inverse image to the coefficient-transported SF strict-reduction-tower product cone. In every cochain degree and at every quotient, its value on an inverse-image unit section is the actual finite-reduction unit followed by the finite inverse-image unit, and its shifted-product coordinate is zero. On each flat-term K-flat representative with constructible derived image, precomposing the ambient comparison with the actual PBC completion unit and following it with the framework pullback realization and canonical complex-localization factors gives the PBC derived pullback counit followed by the localized specified chain map, with the source complex-localization factor inserted. The rational component on every integral object is the localization of the integral component. This defines the data and their normalization, without asserting that such data exist.
